settings.heading: In the language of the kiswah.
settings.text: Every year the Ka'ba is dressed in a new kiswah: black silk, embroidered in gold with the words of Allah. Each frame is made in that language: the calligraphy embroidered in golden silk thread, then framed and finished by hand in Dhaka. Made after the kiswah, never from it.

settings.question: Is it made from the real kiswah?
settings.answer: No. It is made after the kiswah, in its style: embroidered in golden silk thread, then framed and finished by hand in Dhaka. We will never claim otherwise.

settings.question: What does the edition number mean?
settings.answer: Every frame in this first edition is numbered and comes with a signed certificate. Choose all five designs and they carry the same edition number.

settings.question: How big is each frame?
settings.answer: Ya Hayyu, Takbir and Shahadah are 20 × 16 in. Asma ul Husna is 20 × 20 in. Qarib is 22 × 14 in.

settings.question: How do I care for the velvet?
settings.answer: Keep the frame out of direct sunlight and away from damp walls. Dust the glass and frame with a soft, dry cloth; the velvet sits behind glass and needs nothing else.

settings.question: What if it arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Tell us within 14 days, with a photo, and we will replace it or refund you in full.
